items.heading: Read the Exam Notice, Not
items.text: Read the Exam Notice, Not Read the exam notice, not a video. Subject lists, age caps and marks rules sit in the official notice, and they differ by state. Two forest exams in the table above name different degrees.

items.heading: Most Biology Paths Have Two
items.text: Most biology paths have two contests: a hard entry stage and a separate hard advancement stage. A seat is the first.

items.heading: Here Is the Part Few
items.text: Here is the part few pages tell you. The name of your BSc subject can decide whether you may even sit a government exam. Read the official line, not the course brochure.

items.heading: Ask for the Second Step,
items.text: Ask for the second step, not only the first. For every course, ask what happens after graduation: PG seats, NET, government posts or industry hiring, and how many people each takes.

items.heading: Compare Fee Against Entry Pay
items.text: Compare fee against entry pay. Use the pay table. A fee of Rs 6 lakh is about a year of a government forest officer basic, and several years of a private entry pay.

items.heading: Keep a Second Lane Alive
items.text: Keep a second lane alive. Register for one non-NEET route as well. That is planning, not a lack of faith in the first plan.

figures.source: Data analyst entry pay in a PayScale sample of 576 people is Rs 4,13,462 a year, above the microbiologist entry figure of Rs 3,08,652 (81 people). figures.source: Entry pay in PayScale samples: biotechnologist Rs 4,92,168 (44 people), food technologist Rs 3,93,883 (37), microbiologist Rs 3,08,652 (81). Samples are small, so read them as a range, not a promise. Quality and regulatory work rewards documentation skill and pays better after a few years than pure bench work.

figures.label: Pay Range
figures.source: The JRF pays Rs 37,000 a month for two years, then Rs 42,000, up to five years. That is Rs 4,44,000 a year, close to private entry pay, and it buys training, not a job. Only 1.2 percent of NET test-takers in June 2024 reached the top category.
